summary: Read the stored symbolic-link target text without resolving the link target.

semantics.return_value: link target string by default; Buffer with encoding='buffer'
semantics.resolution: returns link payload, not canonical target path

caveats: Do not replace with realpath; relative symlink payloads must remain relative text.
Windows junction/reparse-point behavior may require platform-specific handling.

tests.name: nonlink errors
tests.expected_behavior: throws a Node-compatible error when the path is not a symbolic link
